author: agent
objective: Association of county-level annual PM2.5 with ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mortality rates among US adults aged 65 years and older.

scientific_invariants.research_question: Association of county-level annual PM2.5 with ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke mortality rates among US adults aged 65 years and older.
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: County ischemic- and hemorrhagic-stroke mortality rates per 100,000 among US residents aged 65 years and older.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Additive mortality-rate difference (deaths per 100,000) per 1 µg/m³ higher county-level annual PM2.5.
principal_variants: Univariable linear regression for ischemic stroke
Multivariable linear regression for ischemic stroke adjusted for article-specified covariates
Article-reported stratified race/ethnicity, persistent-poverty, and education variants where covariates are recovered
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: US counties and county equivalents excluding Puerto Rico, American Samoa, Guam, and US Virgin Islands

article_evidence.finding: Complete article specification: county-level 2016–2020 age-65+ ischemic and hemorrhagic mortality rates, PM2.5, ordinary linear regression, and additive per-1 µg/m³ contrast.
Methods and Results provide the model formula, outcomes, population, time period, geographic exclusions, and reported additive coefficient scale.

article_evidence_map.target_discrepancy: Supplied study-target says rate ratio per 10 µg/m³; complete article instead specifies and reports additive linear coefficients per 1 µg/m³. Article controls.

execution_design.assignment_method: Within-county unweighted mean of EPA AQS annual PM2.5 monitor arithmetic means, then equal-weight mean across 2020–2022
execution_design.exposure_metric: County mean of annual PM2.5 monitor means (µg/m³)
execution_design.daily_aggregation: EPA AQS annual concentration archive; no daily aggregation recomputed
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: Three-year mean across 2020–2022 annual county monitor means
execution_design.coverage_policy: Report-only; include counties with observed EPA annual PM2.5 and non-suppressed CDC Atlas outcome; no unsupported completeness cutoff.
execution_design.intended_use: Bounded source- and period-substituted ecological OLS reanalysis; not personal exposure or population-weighted county concentration.

changed_dimensions.assignment_method: Within-county unweighted mean of EPA AQS annual PM2.5 monitor arithmetic means, then equal-weight mean across 2020–2022
changed_dimensions.exposure_metric: County mean of annual PM2.5 monitor means (µg/m³)
changed_dimensions.daily_aggregation: EPA AQS annual concentration archive; no daily aggregation recomputed
changed_dimensions.analysis_aggregation: Three-year mean across 2020–2022 annual county monitor means
changed_dimensions.coverage_policy: Report-only; include counties with observed EPA annual PM2.5 and non-suppressed CDC Atlas outcome; no unsupported completeness cutoff.
changed_dimensions.intended_use: Bounded source- and period-substituted ecological OLS reanalysis; not personal exposure or population-weighted county concentration.

evidence.finding: EPA annual archives yield 643 counties with PM2.5 and 551 ischemic-outcome/exposure overlaps; CDC Atlas produces 2020–2022 age-65+ county outcome records.
CDC Atlas configuration documents Ischemic Stroke and Hemorrhagic Stroke death-rate themes and age/race/sex/time filters.

amendments.scientific_justification: The complete article does not name an exposure source. EPA AQS is a public regulatory monitor archive with usable 2020–2022 annual PM2.5 records. The current public Atlas exposes 2020–2022 rather than 2016–2020. This is a bounded analysis retaining county ecological spatial support, target outcomes, PM2.5, and OLS model family while explicitly changing exposure implementation, period, and adjustment.
